text:
[Council File 26-1170]
Motion (Padilla - Park) relative to the impacts of the Mayor’s proposed Capital Infrastructure Plan and the Bureau of Engineering’s proposed capital project intake process.
(This item was referred to the Public Works Committee, Government Operations Committee, and Budget and Finance Committee)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Reviewing the impacts of the Mayor's proposed Capital Infrastructure Plan and Bureau of Engineering's proposed capital project intake process.

outcome.text: Budget and Finance Committee concurred with the Public Works Committee's action of August 26, 2026 and the Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee's action of September 16, 2026 to approve Motion (Padilla - Park) (Oct 6, 2026)
